# Boards and lists

A board holds lists, and a list holds cards. Use a board for one stream of
work: a launch, a team's sprint, or a hiring round.

## Cards

Select **Add card** at the bottom of a list. A card can carry a due date,
people, labels and a checklist. Drag a card to move it to another list.

## Archive a board

Open the board menu and select **Archive**. An archived board disappears from
the sidebar. Admins can find it again under **Settings > Archived boards**.
